name: Witch
description:
Keepers of Balance, Makers of Things Right

Witches practice magic the way others practice care. Their power emerges through patience, routine, and intimate attention to the world around them. A Witch’s spells are often woven into everyday acts—preparing food, tending wounds, warding thresholds—yet their effects are profound and enduring.

Rather than bending reality through force, Witches maintain balance, reinforcing boundaries, restoring what is broken, and binding what should not roam free.

Where others take shortcuts,
Witches make things right.

Domains of Magic

Witches excel at magic that preserves, protects, and corrects:

  • Healing and restoration

  • Wards, boundaries, and sanctuaries

  • Purification and curse-breaking

  • Anti-magic and suppression

  • Binding, imprisonment, and inevitability

Taboo: Shortcuts

Witches despise magic that ignores consequences.

What is rushed will return.

Fault Lines

  • Channelers threaten balance through excess.

  • Votaries invoke power without tending aftermath.
